translated: I wanted to, but that woman died on her own.
It's the same as if you killed her!

All is by the will of Lord Odin.
What is wrong with gods reincarnating souls?

Right now I'm nothing but Odin's mercenary.
Struggling won't change a thing.
What can you do with so few!?

...You're always like this.
Lord Odin, Lord Odin, every other word...

I'm tired of hearing Odin's will.
I want to hear your thoughts.

Do not forget that we are beings
who serve Lord Odin!

I've had enough! There's no reason
gods may mock humans!
You seek momentary comfort in battle...
